newsitem.title: USA: FNB, West Coast agree to merge.
newsitem.headline: FNB, West Coast agree to merge.

text.p: FNB Corp and West Coast Bancorp Inc said Friday they have signed a definitive agreement for West Coast to merge into Southwest Banks Inc, a future subsidiary of FNB.
Under terms of the agreement, each share of West Coast will be exchanged for 0.794 share of FNB, a statement from FNB said.
The company said West Coast shareholders will receive increased cash dividends approximating $0.13 per share over the next two quarters.
The company said the consideration received by West Coast shareholders will total $18.88 per share.
FNB said it will issue 1.3 million shares in the tax-free exchange, making the total value of the transaction about $31 million.
